title: Questions 168-171 refer to the following e-mail.
passage_1:
To:Helena Brandt <h.brandt@arborhotels.com>
From:Samuel Oyelaran <s.oyelaran@caldera-ceramics.com>
Date:April 2
Subject:Your Visit

Dear Ms. Brandt,

We are delighted to confirm your place on the tour of the Caldera Ceramics works next Thursday. This visit has been arranged for hospitality buyers who are interested in stocking our new tableware range.

Please arrive at the reception desk by 9:30 A.M. – [1] –. You will be met by our production manager, who will lead the tour. The route takes in the glazing room, the kiln hall, and the quality-control bench. – [2] –.

For your safety, please make sure that you wear flat, closed shoes. – [3] –. We will supply aprons and eye protection. Because our glaze recipes are confidential, photography is not permitted anywhere inside the works. – [4] –.

We look forward to showing you how our methods set us apart from other producers.

Sincerely,

Samuel Oyelaran
Visitor Programme Manager
